title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Accounts Assistant - Weston-super-Mare - £26,000 - £29,000

If you're looking to build on your accountancy experience and broaden your exposure across accounts, tax and client work, this could be an excellent opportunity to take the next step.

Trial Balance are delighted to be working with a respected accountancy practice who are looking to recruit an Accounts Assistant to join its team in Weston-super-Mare. This is a varied role offering the opportunity to work with a diverse portfolio of clients, develop your technical skills and gain valuable experience across a broad range of accounting and taxation work.

As Accounts Assistant, your responsibilities will include:
- Preparing financial statements for limited companies, partnerships and sole traders
- Assisting with personal and corporate tax
- Providing bookkeeping and management accounting support across a varied client portfolio
- Preparing and submitting quarterly VAT returns
- Maintaining accurate and up-to-date accounting records for clients
- Responding to day-to-day client queries and developing strong working relationships
- Supporting Partners, Managers and colleagues with wider accounting tasks and ad-hoc projects

The successful Accounts Assistant will:

Have previous experience within an accountancy practice and a good grounding across accounts preparation, bookkeeping and tax.

AAT qualification or equivalent experience would be advantageous, although candidates who are building their experience within practice will also be considered. You'll be organised, accurate and confident communicating with clients and colleagues, with a positive attitude towards learning and development. The ability to manage your own workload, meet deadlines and work effectively as part of a team will also be important.

This is an excellent opportunity for an Accounts Assistant who wants to develop within accountancy practice and gain broader experience than you might expect from a traditional junior accounts role. You'll enjoy regular client contact, varied technical work and the support of an experienced team.

To discuss this Accounts Assistant opportunity in more detail, please contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith quoting reference JVS11302, or submit your application today.

Trial Balance is a market leading supplier of recruitment services to accountancy practices across the South-West and works on vacancies at all levels in a practice environment. For a confidential discussion about your career options please contact Jay Vilarrubi-Smith, our dedicated practice specialist.

title: Finance Administrator
description:
Finance Administrator (Accounts Payable)

Location: Yeovil, Somerset
Salary: 25,000 - 27,000 PA
Hours: Monday - Friday, 9am - 5pm (1 hour lunch)

Benefits
- 25 days holiday plus Bank Holidays
- 5% Contributory Pension
- Free parking

Looking to build a career in finance?

We're recruiting for a Finance Administrator to join a friendly and supportive team of 7 in Yeovil. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with previous experience in accounts payable, finance, or administration, but we're also keen to hear from individuals who are naturally organised, enjoy working with numbers and data, and are looking to develop a career within finance.

If you're detail-oriented, proactive, and enjoy problem-solving, this could be a great next step for you.

The Role

As a Finance Administrator, you'll play an important role in supporting the day-to-day running of the finance department. You'll work closely with suppliers and colleagues across the business to ensure invoices, payments and financial records are processed accurately and efficiently.

This is a varied position where no two days are quite the same, offering plenty of opportunity to learn and develop your finance knowledge.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing and verifying supplier invoices
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and ensuring correct coding and approvals
- Preparing and assisting with supplier payment runs
- Monitoring payment deadlines and ensuring payments are made on time
- Investigating and resolving invoice queries and payment discrepancies
- Building positive relationships with suppliers and responding to enquiries
- Reconciling supplier statements and resolving outstanding issues
- Maintaining accurate financial records and supporting finance administration tasks
- Working closely with colleagues across the business to support the wider finance function

About You

We're looking for someone who is:
- Organised with excellent attention to detail
- Comfortable working with numbers, data and spreadsheets
- Confident communicating with colleagues, customers and suppliers
- Proactive and willing to learn
- Able to manage their workload effectively
- Reliable, positive and team-focused

Previous finance or accounts payable experience would be beneficial, but it's not essential. If you've worked in an administrative role, enjoy working with numbers, and are keen to develop a career in finance, we'd love to hear from you.

Don't Tick Every Box?

Please don't let that stop you from applying. We're interested in people with the right attitude, willingness to learn, and transferable skills just as much as direct experience. If this opportunity sounds like a good fit for you, we'd encourage you to apply.

How to Apply

To apply for this role, please do so online, email your CV to (url removed), or call Vicky on (phone number removed) for a confidential chat.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant

Langport Up to £32,000 Full Time

Butler Rose is delighted to be exclusively partnering with a well-established and successful Somerset-based business to recruit a Finance Assistant to join their finance team in Langport. This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to develop a long-term career in finance within a supportive environment that offers exposure across multiple areas of the accounts function. The employer is also happy to support CIMA studies for the right candidate.

The Role

Reporting directly to the Financial Controller, you'll play a key role within a close-knit finance team and gain experience across a broad range of financial responsibilities.

Key duties will include:
- Maintaining accurate sales and purchase ledger records
- Processing customer invoices and supplier transactions
- Reconciling ledger accounts and resolving discrepancies
- Assisting with payroll processing and employee records
- Supporting weekly and monthly management accounts preparation
- Assisting with financial reporting, forecasting and audit requirements
- Preparing and checking export documentation
- Liaising with customers, suppliers and internal stakeholders
- Providing general support across the finance function as required

About You

Applicants will ideally have:
- Previous experience within an Accounts Assistant or similar finance role
- Knowledge of sales ledger, purchase ledger and general accounting processes
- Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
- Good Excel and systems skills
- Excellent communication skills
- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Knowledge of payroll processes or accounting qualifications would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer
- Salary up to £32,000
- Full-time permanent position
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm
- Office-based role in Langport
- Support towards CIMA studies
- Opportunity to gain exposure across multiple areas of finance
- Stable, supportive and collaborative team environment

This is an exclusive assignment being managed by Butler Rose. To be considered, please apply today or contact Butler Rose for a confidential discussion.

Butler Rose is committed to equality in the workplace and welcomes applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Butler Rose is committed to equality in the workplace and is an equal opportunity employer.
Butler Rose Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Country: United Kingdom
Job Type: Full Time
Workplace Type: Hybrid
Seniority Level: Associate

Hydro International, a CRH Company, is a leading global provider of advanced products, services and expertise to help municipal, industrial and construction customers to improve their water management processes, increase operational performance and reduce environmental impact. With over 40 years of experience and a reputation for engineering excellence, businesses, and public bodies all over the world rely on our products, services and integrated solutions to reduce flood risk, improve water treatment and protect the environment from water pollution. We have a network of over 80 distribution partners and serve customers in more than 40 countries. As part of CRH Infrastructure Products, we are leading the water management industry with innovative, sustainable solutions and a safety-first mindset.
Finance Assistant - Sales Ledger & Credit Control

Clevedon, UK

Join Hydro International and help drive financial excellence

At Hydro International, we're looking for a proactive and organised Finance Assistant to join our Transactional Finance team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with sales ledger and credit control experience who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and wants to contribute to continuous improvement within a growing global business.

As the first point of contact for all sales ledger activities within our Services division, you'll play a key role in maintaining robust financial controls, managing customer accounts and supporting cash collection activities. You'll work closely with both internal colleagues and external customers, helping to ensure the smooth operation of our finance processes.

What you'll be doing
- Raising sales invoices and Applications for Payment
- Updating customer portals and ensuring invoicing controls are maintained
- Managing credit control activities and chasing outstanding debt
- Working with customers and Project Managers to resolve payment queries
- Maintaining debtor days in line with company targets
- Posting cash receipts and completing bank reconciliations
- Producing debtor reports for internal and external stakeholders
- Supporting compliance with credit insurance requirements
- Contributing to process improvements and finance best practice initiatives

What we're looking for
- Previous experience within a Sales Ledger, Accounts Receivable or Credit Control role
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel
- Experience using finance or ERP systems, ideally Microsoft Business Central
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload effectively
- A proactive, self-motivated approach and willingness to drive improvements
- Comfortable working in a changing and evolving environment

Why join Hydro International?

This is an exciting time to join Hydro. As part of our "One Hydro" transformation programme, we're preparing for a new ERP implementation that will shape the future of our finance operations. You'll have the opportunity to work within a collaborative team environment and play a key role in supporting this business-wide change.

We offer the opportunity to grow your career within a global organisation that values innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement.

Why Work for Us?
- Life Cover
- Company Pension Scheme
- Sick Pay Policy
- 25 days holiday per year + Bank Holidays
- Mental Health First Aiders & wellbeing support programmes
- Flu vaccinations
- DSE eye tests
- Training & development opportunities

Apply Today

If you're an experienced Finance Assistant, Sales Ledger Administrator or Credit Controller looking for your next opportunity, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and become part of the Hydro International team.
What Hydro International Offers You
- A culture that values opportunity for growth, development, and internal promotion
- Highly competitive salary package
- Comprehensive secondary benefits
- Significant contribution to your pension plan
- Excellent opportunities to develop and progress with a global organization

Connect your future to CRH

We are curious to learn more about you. At CRH, we believe our mutual differences contribute to the healthy, productive, and enjoyable workspace we create. Please introduce yourself and send us your application.
Is this role not for you, but do you know someone who would love to join the team? Please let us know!

title: HR and Payroll
description:
This varied role will involve payroll administration, maintaining HR records and systems, supporting employee life cycle processes, producing HR reports, and providing day-to-day support to managers and employees.

Client Details

FMCG - Frome

Description

We're looking for an organised and detail-oriented HR & Payroll Administrator to support the smooth day-to-day running of our HR and payroll activities. This is a varied position where you'll play a crucial role in ensuring employee records are accurate, payroll information is processed correctly, and colleagues across the business receive a high standard of support.

If you have previous payroll experience, excellent organisational skills, and enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, we'd love to hear from you.

As the HR and Payroll Administrator, you'll be responsible for:
- Supporting the accurate and timely processing of payroll information
- Maintaining employee data across HR, payroll, and Time & Attendance systems
- Ensuring employee records and documentation are accurate and up to date
- Collating monthly salary data and checking authorised hours against exception reports
- Preparing and processing HR documentation relating to recruitment, onboarding, training, performance reviews, grievances, and other employee matters
- Producing HR reports and supporting KPI data collection and analysis
- Managing absence records and supporting attendance management processes
- Coordinating Occupational Health referrals and appointments
- Supporting the delivery of inductions for new starters
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to employees and managers
- Assisting with HR projects and wider people initiatives
- Maintaining accurate electronic and paper-based records

Profile

To be successful in this role, you'll have:
- Previous Payroll & HR administration experience
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Experience using HR, payroll, or Time & Attendance systems
- Experience producing reports and analysing HR metrics/KPI data
- Strong IT, organisational, and administrative skills
- The ability to manage multiple priorities effectively
- Strong written and verbal communication skills
- A customer-focused approach with excellent service skills
- The confidence to work independently and take ownership of tasks
- A flexible and adaptable mindset
- The ability to thrive in a busy, fast-paced environment
- A genuine interest in supporting people and delivering a great employee experience

Job Offer
- Salary up to 34k + Great benefits
- Opportunity to develop your HR and payroll expertise
- Varied and hands-on role with broad responsibilities
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- On-site 5 days a week - Frome

If you're an organised HR & Payroll professional looking for your next challenge in a people-focused business, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more about this opportunity based in Frome.

title: Payroll Assistant
description:
Job Title: Payroll Assistant

Location: Yeovil, Somerset

Salary: 28,000 - 31,000 PA DOE

Hours: 30-37.5 hours, Monday to Friday flexible dependant on the candidate. The company also offers flexi time with 10-4 being the core hours

Benefits: 25 days plus Bank Holidays, Xmas Closure, Free Parking, Death in Service, Cycle to Work Scheme, Staff Socials, Modern Offices

Are you experienced in payroll looking for your next opportunity within a friendly and professional business? We're working with a well-established and growing accountancy practice in Yeovil who are looking to add a detail-focused payroll professional to their team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys managing payroll processes, building strong client relationships, and working in a supportive environment where accuracy and customer service are highly valued. They are always developing their staff and will fully support you with further qualifications and achieving your CIPP Level 3

The Role

As a Payroll Assistant, you'll be responsible for managing a portfolio of payroll clients and ensuring payrolls are processed accurately and on time. You'll work closely with clients, HMRC, and pension providers while ensuring all statutory deadlines are consistently met.

Key Responsibilities
- Processing weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls for a variety of clients
- Setting up new payroll clients and HMRC accounts
- Processing starters, leavers and payroll amendments
- Submitting RTI reports to HMRC
- Issuing employee payslips and payroll summaries to clients
- Managing auto-enrolment pension submissions and reconciliations
- Calculating and reconciling PAYE payments and Attachment of Earnings Orders
- Liaising with pension providers regarding client schemes
- Responding to payroll-related queries from clients and HMRC
- Ensuring compliance with payroll legislation and filing deadlines
- Supporting colleagues across the wider team as required
- Assisting with administrative duties, system updates and general office support
- Providing clients with up-to-date information on payroll legislation changes

About You

To be successful in this role, you'll ideally have:
- Previous payroll administration experience
- Strong understanding of payroll legislation and compliance requirements
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Confident communication skills and a professional telephone manner
- Ability to manage multiple deadlines and prioritise workloads effectively
- Strong IT skills and experience using payroll software
- A proactive approach and willingness to support the wider team

If you're an organised and reliable payroll professional looking for a new challenge, we'd love to hear from you.
